_purpose: Ratchet baselines for the donor audits. Each number is the highest problem count that was true and recorded at the stated date. A run that produces MORE problems than this baseline fails; producing fewer requires lowering the baseline in the same change, so donor drift cannot be re-introduced silently.
donor_gate_note: eng/check-donor-sources.py --local-only: 17 issues across 24 bindings, all 'no app-local source tree' for declared-but-never-vendored donors, none from a pin. Avalonia now passes as a framework-scope donor via recorded fork equivalence rather than a gitlink.
census_note: eng/development/donor_policy.py census: 29 donor rows, 0 violations, 6 findings. Findings are recorded drift (Rnote patches absent from the consumed pin, fork not consumed yet, Avalonia and Files as loose vendored trees) and stay visible in the log.
coverage_note: eng/development/donor_coverage.py audit: 28 specification designations over 25 distinct donors. 24 problems = 13 undeclared designated donors (12 distinct: blender, cakemods, comaps, element-matrix, gitea, gitnuro, gnome-system-monitor, godot, lawnchair, strata, thunderbird, virtualbox) + 2 designated donors with no .gitmodules entry (files: loose vendored copy; llama-cpp: consumed as a pinned prebuilt binary) + 9 registry bindings this audit cannot match to a specification designation (code-oss, vscodium, eds, libical, glycin, loupe, gstreamer, ges, libvterm) - of which the Planner pair contradicts the specification's own 'no external application donor is currently normative' wording and the VS Code pair contradicts 'Build is one application; Dev is not an app'.
coverage_note_history: Previously 26 problems; Avalonia was declared as a framework-scope donor with a blob-level fork-equivalence receipt, resolving its two designations (lines 1816, 1830). The underlying debt for the remaining 24 is unchanged - only a real declaration reduced the count.
